Content heading left is much smaller than hero: 'Creator content. / Built for the feed.' at40-46px; supporting copy 'Creators publish in their own voice. We run the operation behind it.' at20px. Right next content stage: THREE actual vertical video sources (reference2 Judy, reference3 Jack, reference4 phone product demo). Keep videos in precise fixed rectangular9:16 panels, approximately230x409 each, same top AND bottom alignment, never angled, no large rounding, no shadows. Captions underneath exactly '@judyintech · Instagram', '@jack.jobsearch · TikTok', 'Product demo'. Do not fabricate social metrics.

Below three-media stage a slim elegant horizontal progress line with three small equal-size dot stops, first orange, others charcoal; don't add another giant orange accent. This is local scroll progress. Plenty of black space near lower edge implies continuation, not a footer. This concept does NOT show map yet, reserve the orange full-page colour moment for later. No beige or stone return. No 8-to-infinity footer yet. No diagram, no repeated giant title, no circle headshots, no new colour panels or extra decorative captions.
Overall: editorial restraint, powerful identity at hero, product proof below on one continuous surface, clean fixed geometries ready for tiny scroll-triggered changes. Sharply readable type and polished exact alignment.

Use the same carbon background, same precise original logo, same navigation rail and same media content. Frames are sequential viewport positions IN ONE DOCUMENT, never separate page designs. Outside frames simple neutral graphite board margins, tiny clear white caption labels. No gratuitous art direction. Board heading 'One page. Small movements.'
Inputs: ref1 is the refined full continuous page. Refs2-4 are original Judy / Jack / phone video posters. Preserve reference actualmedia rather than invent people. Hero studio group only exists in hero and scrolls out. In frames3 and4 it is GONE. No new huge headings, diagrams or orange backgrounds.
FRAME1 '01 — SCROLL, DON’T SWITCH'. Viewport catches bottom60% of hero portrait group and orange disc at top, with the smaller 'Creator content. Built for the feed.' area starting immediately underneath. ONE slim header at very top. Both areas share continuous #111111 black. Studio portraits static, moving upward only with normal page scroll. No boundary line or huge gap.
FRAME2 '02 — A SMALL ARRIVAL'. Same page scrolled about250px farther. A narrow strip of hero shoulders remains at top just below header; now real-content area nearly fully visible. Left heading 40px not massive: 'Creator content. / Built for the feed.' Under it exact copy 'Creators publish in their own voice. We run the operation behind it.' Right same three real colour video frames Judy / Jack / phone demo aligned in a row at equal9:16 geometry, unrotated, no fake dashboard. They settle just12px vertically with a brief opacity entrance. FRAME3 '03 — THE READING AREA HOLDS'. Scroll a bit further, hero entirely above viewport. Real-work reading area now at a comfortable position below header. Freeze its geometry for frame4. Same heading and paragraph left, three compact text selectors 'Career discovery', 'Job-search advice', 'Product in action'. First selected with small orange dot and underline. FRAME4 '04 — ONLY THE FOCUS CHANGES'. Pixel-identical positions to frame3, no media shifting, scaling or rearranging, no changes to headline or paragraph. Middle text selector now underlined orange. Caption changes to 'A job-search hook made for the feed.' Orange baseline now under JACK, Judy baseline becomes dark; Jack media gets playback control and natural brightness, Judy pauses and dims slightly. Small progress point moves to second stop. All three real posters remain EXACTLY same sizes and positions, no new photos. This is scroll-driven focus within one stable region, not a slider that flies across the screen. Use the original Jack image with yellow shirt. Do not fabricate different footage frame.
Outside frames the short captions below each explain: 'Natural document movement.' / '12px entrance, 300ms.' / 'Copy and media frames stay put.' / 'Caption + underline + dot, 180–250ms.'
Bottom board note 'Native scroll · Three real clips · One active video · Reduced-motion alternative'. No map, beige, orange page takeover or infinity footer in this board; those are future design tasks. This board should illustrate subtle local keyframes persuasively, with almost identical frames3/4 so the user sees that the PAGE DOES NOT CHANGE. Beautiful readable type and faithful layout continuity matter much more than extra spectacle.
